tool.name: IsobaricWorkflow
tool.description: Calculates isobaric quantitative values for peptides
tool.command:
@QUOTE_FOO@ @EXT_FOO@ #import re
## Preprocessing mkdir in_cond.in && #if $in_cond.in_select == "no" mkdir ${' '.join(["'in_cond.in/%s'" % (i) for i, f in enumerate($in_cond.in) if f])} && ${' '.join(["cp '%s' 'in_cond.in/%s/%s.%s' && " % (f, i, re.sub('[^\w\-_]', '_', f.element_identifier), $gxy2omsext(f.ext)) for i, f in enumerate($in_cond.in) if f])} #else cp '$in_cond.in' 'in_cond.in/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $in_cond.in.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($in_cond.in.ext)' && #end if mkdir in_id_cond.in_id && #if $in_id_cond.in_id_select == "no" mkdir ${' '.join(["'in_id_cond.in_id/%s'" % (i) for i, f in enumerate($in_id_cond.in_id) if f])} && ${' '.join(["cp '%s' 'in_id_cond.in_id/%s/%s.%s' && " % (f, i, re.sub('[^\w\-_]', '_', f.element_identifier), $gxy2omsext(f.ext)) for i, f in enumerate($in_id_cond.in_id) if f])} #else cp '$in_id_cond.in_id' 'in_id_cond.in_id/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $in_id_cond.in_id.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($in_id_cond.in_id.ext)' && #end if #if $exp_design: mkdir exp_design && cp '$exp_design' 'exp_design/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $exp_design.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($exp_design.ext)' && #end if #if "out_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') mkdir out && #end if #if "out_mzTab_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') mkdir out_mzTab && #end if
## Main program call
set -o pipefail && @EXECUTABLE@ -write_ctd ./ && python3 '$__tool_directory__/fill_ctd.py' '@EXECUTABLE@.ctd' '$args_json' '$hardcoded_json' && @EXECUTABLE@ -ini @EXECUTABLE@.ctd -in #if $in_cond.in_select == "no" ${' '.join(["'in_cond.in/%s/%s.%s'"%(i, re.sub('[^\w\-_]', '_', f.element_identifier), $gxy2omsext(f.ext)) for i, f in enumerate($in_cond.in) if f])} #else 'in_cond.in/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $in_cond.in.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($in_cond.in.ext)' #end if -in_id #if $in_id_cond.in_id_select == "no" ${' '.join(["'in_id_cond.in_id/%s/%s.%s'"%(i, re.sub('[^\w\-_]', '_', f.element_identifier), $gxy2omsext(f.ext)) for i, f in enumerate($in_id_cond.in_id) if f])} #else 'in_id_cond.in_id/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $in_id_cond.in_id.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($in_id_cond.in_id.ext)' #end if #if $exp_design: -exp_design 'exp_design/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $exp_design.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($exp_design.ext)' #end if #if "out_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') -out 'out/output.${gxy2omsext("consensusxml")}' #end if #if "out_mzTab_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') -out_mzTab 'out_mzTab/output.${gxy2omsext("mztab")}' #end if #if len(str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',')) == 0 | tee '$stdout' #end if
## Postprocessing #if "out_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') && mv 'out/output.${gxy2omsext("consensusxml")}' '$out' #end if #if "out_mzTab_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') && mv 'out_mzTab/output.${gxy2omsext("mztab")}' '$out_mzTab' #end if #if "ctd_out_FLAG" in $OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS && mv '@EXECUTABLE@.ctd' '$ctd_out' #end if

param.help: Only used for MS3, otherwise it is the same as the quant. precursor purity

param.help: (use 'NAN' to disable this filter)

param.label: The score which should be reached by a protein hit to be kept
param.help: All proteins are filtered based on their singleton scores irrespective of grouping. Use in combination with 'delete_unreferenced_peptide_hits' to remove affected peptides. (use 'NAN' to disable this filter)

param.label: Peptides not referenced by any protein are deleted in the IDs
Methods used for protein inference

FDR threshold for sub-protein level (e.g. 0.05=5%)

param.name: method
param.label: - top - quantify based on three most abundant peptides (number can be changed in 'top')
param.help: - iBAQ (intensity based absolute quantification), calculate the sum of all peptide peak intensities divided by the number of theoretically observable tryptic peptides (https://rdcu.be/cND1J). Warning: only consensusXML or featureXML input is allowed!

param.name: best_charge
param.label: Distinguish between fraction and charge states in detailed peptide output
param.help: For protein quantification, select one charge per modified peptide globally: maximize the number of (fraction group, label) assays with a positive abundance, then break ties by total abundance; retain that charge's values in every assay.. By default, protein abundances are summed over all charge states. How the retained values of several fractions are combined is governed by 'fractions:aggregate', not by this flag

section.name: top
section.title: Additional options for custom quantification using top N peptides

param.name: N
param.label: Calculate protein abundance from this number of proteotypic peptides (most abundant first; '0' for all)

param.name: aggregate
param.label: Aggregation method used to compute protein abundances from peptide abundances

param.name: include_all
param.label: Include results for proteins with fewer proteotypic peptides than indicated by 'N' (no effect if 'N' is 0 or 1)

section.name: fractions
section.title: Options for combining the fractions of a fraction group

param.name: aggregate
param.label: How the fractions of one fraction group are combined into that group's (fraction group, label) assay values
param.help: - sum - add up every fraction, i.e. treat them as the parts of one separated sample that they are.. - best - keep a single fraction per peptide and fraction group and discard the others. The fraction is chosen ONCE per peptide, ranked by the number of labels in which it has a positive abundance and then by the total of those abundances (an exact tie keeps the lowest fraction number), and ALL of its labels are then taken from it. The choice is deliberately not made per label: taking one channel from one fraction and another channel from a different fraction would mix physical aliquots and destroy the reporter-ion ratios that isobaric quantification consists of.. Only the assay values are affected. Per-(file, channel) quantities are per fraction by definition and always report every file

section.name: consensus
section.title: Additional options for consensus maps (and identification results comprising multiple runs)

param.name: normalize
param.label: Scale peptide abundances so that the median of each (fraction group, label) assay matches the overall median
param.help: Abundances of zero count as 'not detected' and are left out of the medians; an assay without any positive abundance takes no part in the normalization

param.name: fix_peptides
param.label: Use the same peptides for protein quantification across all (fraction group, label) assays
param.help: With 'N 0',all peptides that occur in every assay are considered.. Otherwise ('N'), the N peptides that occur in the most assays (independently of each other) are selected,. breaking ties by total abundance (there is no guarantee that the best co-ocurring peptides are chosen!).. A peptide counts as occurring in an assay only where its abundance is positive: an abundance stored as zero means 'not detected' (e.g. an isobaric reporter below 'min_reporter_intensity'), not a measurement of absence

param.name: min_peptides_per_protein
param.label: Minimal number of peptides needed for a protein identification
param.help: If set to zero, unmatched proteins get a score of -Infinity. If bigger than zero, proteins with less peptides are filtered and evidences removed from the PSMs. PSMs that do not reference any proteins anymore are removed but the spectrum info is kept

param.name: score_aggregation_method
param.label: How to aggregate scores of peptides matching to the same protein?

param.name: treat_charge_variants_separately
param.label: If this is true, different charge variants of the same peptide sequence count as individual evidences

param.name: treat_modification_variants_separately
param.label: If this is true, different modification variants of the same peptide sequence count as individual evidences

param.name: use_shared_peptides
param.label: If this is true, shared peptides are used as evidences
param.help: Note: shared_peptides are not deleted and potentially resolved in postprocessing as well

param.name: skip_count_annotation
param.label: If this is set, peptide counts won't be annotated at the proteins

param.name: score_type
param.label: PSM score type to use for inference
param.help: (default: empty = main score)

param.name: psm_probability_cutoff
param.label: Remove PSMs with probabilities less than this cutoff

param.name: top_PSMs
param.label: Consider only top X PSMs per spectrum
param.help: 0 considers all

param.name: keep_best_PSM_only
param.label: Epifany uses the best PSM per peptide for inference
param.help: Discard the rest (true) or keepe.g. for quantification/reporting?

section.name: model_parameters
section.title: Model parameters for the Bayesian network

param.name: prot_prior
param.label: Protein prior probability ('gamma' parameter)
param.help: Negative values enable grid search for this param

param.name: pep_emission
param.label: Peptide emission probability ('alpha' parameter)
param.help: Negative values enable grid search for this param

param.name: pep_spurious_emission
param.label: Spurious peptide identification probability ('beta' parameter)
param.help: Usually much smaller than emission from proteins. Negative values enable grid search for this param

param.name: pep_prior
param.label: Peptide prior probability (experimental, should be covered by combinations of the other params)

param.name: regularize
param.label: Regularize the number of proteins that produce a peptide together (experimental, should be activated when using higher p-norms)

param.name: extended_model
param.label: Uses information from different peptidoforms also across runs (automatically activated if an experimental design is given!)

section.name: loopy_belief_propagation
section.title: Settings for the loopy belief propagation algorithm

param.name: scheduling_type
param.label: (Not used yet) How to pick the next message: priority = based on difference to last message (higher = more important)
param.help: fifo = first in first out. subtree = message passing follows a random spanning tree in each iteration

param.name: convergence_threshold
param.label: Initial threshold under which MSE difference a message is considered to be converged

param.name: dampening_lambda
param.label: Initial value for how strongly should messages be updated in each step
param.help: 0 = new message overwrites old completely (no dampening; only recommended for trees),0.5 = equal contribution of old and new message (stay below that),In-between it will be a convex combination of both. Prevents oscillations but hinders convergence

param.name: max_nr_iterations
param.label: (Usually auto-determined by estimated but you can set a hard limit here)
param.help: If not all messages converge, how many iterations should be done at max per connected component?

param.name: p_norm_inference
param.label: P-norm used for marginalization of multidimensional factors
param.help: 1 == sum-product inference (all configurations vote equally) (default),<= 0 == infinity = max-product inference (only best configurations propagate)The higher the value the more important high probability configurations get

param.name: aucweight
param.label: How important is target decoy AUC vs calibration of the posteriors
param.help: 0 = maximize calibration only, 1 = maximize AUC only, between = convex combination

param.name: conservative_fdr
param.label: Use (D+1)/(T) instead of (D+1)/(T+D) for parameter estimation

param.name: regularized_fdr
param.label: Use a regularized FDR for proteins without unique peptides

param.name: select_activation
param.label: Operate only on MSn scans where any of its precursors features a certain activation method
param.help: Setting to "auto" uses HCD and HCID spectra. Set to empty string if you want to disable filtering

option.value: Electron transfer and higher-energy collision dissociation

param.option: Electron transfer and higher-energy collision dissociation

param.name: reporter_mass_shift
param.label: Allowed shift (left to right) in Th from the expected position

param.name: min_precursor_intensity
param.label: Minimum intensity of the precursor to be extracted
param.help: MS/MS scans having a precursor with a lower intensity will not be considered for quantitation

param.name: keep_unannotated_precursor
param.label: Flag if precursor with missing intensity value or missing precursor spectrum should be included or not

param.name: min_reporter_intensity
param.label: Minimum intensity of the individual reporter ions to be extracted

param.name: discard_low_intensity_quantifications
param.label: Remove all reporter intensities if a single reporter is below the threshold given in 'min_reporter_intensity'

param.name: min_precursor_purity
param.label: Minimum fraction of the total intensity in the isolation window of the precursor spectrum attributable to the selected precurso

param.name: precursor_isotope_deviation
param.label: Maximum allowed deviation (in ppm) between theoretical and observed isotopic peaks of the precursor peak in the isolation window to be counted as part of the precurso

param.name: purity_interpolation
param.label: If set to true the algorithm will try to compute the purity as a time weighted linear combination of the precursor scan and the following scan
param.help: If set to false, only the precursor scan will be used
